presentation.title: Blank Map
presentation.intro: Every province of the present-day world with no owner assigned. Paint your own alternate history from scratch: countries, borders and colours are entirely up to you.

presentation.title: The Gathering Storm
presentation.intro: The world three years before the Second World War. Germany is rearming and about to remilitarise the Rhineland, Italy is at war in Ethiopia, and Spain is months from civil war. In Asia, Japan holds Manchukuo while China remains divided among the Nationalist government, the Communists and regional warlords.
layers: Preset special zones (off by default): Rhineland, Turkish Straits, Danzig

presentation.title: Blitzkrieg
presentation.tagline: 14 August 1939 · On the eve of war
presentation.intro: Two weeks before the invasion of Poland. Germany has annexed Austria, the Sudetenland and Bohemia-Moravia, Italy has occupied Albania, and the Spanish Civil War has just ended. In the Far East, Japan has been at war with China for two years.
layers: Preset special zones (off by default): Danzig, Yellow River flood zone

presentation.title: Modern World
presentation.intro: The political map of 2026, including occupied and de facto independent areas such as Russian-held eastern Ukraine, Northern Cyprus and divided Kashmir.
layers: Preset special zones (off by default): Golan Heights, Russian-held Ukraine, Kashmir, Northern Cyprus

presentation.title: The New Order, 1962
presentation.tagline: 1962 · Alternate history after an Axis victory
presentation.intro: An alternate 1962 in which Germany won the Second World War. The Greater Germanic Reich rules Europe up to the Arkhangelsk–Astrakhan line through its Reichskommissariats, Japan leads the Co-Prosperity Sphere in Asia, and the United States heads the OFN. East of the line, Russia has collapsed into rival warlord states.
layers: Atlantropa: the Gibraltar dam has lowered the Mediterranean, exposing salt flats and a new coastline
Preset special zones (off by default): demilitarised zones, Gotenland settlement area, Suez
